escena: SCENE (Efeonce studio, Santiago, afternoon): the windowless production room of the Efeonce studio, looking towards its far end 4 m away, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view; horizon level, verticals straight. LEFT THIRD: the matte dark-navy side wall carries Image 2 exactly — the small question with its orange ring and the huge answer «Todos» with its orange sphere as the period — as crisp matte white and orange vinyl, high on the wall. RIGHT SIDE: along the right wall runs a large LED video wall seen in steep perspective, receding towards the far end, made of the 18 screens of Image 3 (three rows of six) and showing exactly that content: the same key visual adapted into every format, each with its small format label, glowing. CENTRE: the far end of the room stays calm, a matte dark-navy wall in deep, detailed shade, with no screens and no light spots behind where the person sits. At the bottom LEFT, on the edge of a slim modern control console, the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid WHITE desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright between 4% and 24% of the frame width, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), matte white finish, crisp bevel. LIGHT: the video wall is the light source: its cool blue light with small warm orange flecks spills across the microcement floor and the console, and a low clean haze makes that light visible as soft volumetric glow in the right half of the room; the left wall is lit only by that spill. TRACES OF WORK: a graphite mesh chair pushed back at an angle by the console, a slim keyboard left askew. MODERN FLOOR (2026, premium technology company): smooth exposed concrete ceiling with recessed black linear LED profiles switched off; seamless microcement floor; furniture with clean lines on slim black steel legs; current-generation technology only. At most ONE sculptural plant in the whole frame. Nothing vintage or rustic, no clutter. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artworks from Image 2 and Image 3 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen or label stays illegible by physical means.
